input.quote: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
input.rationale: Section 9 is mutual ("either party's liability") and already places indemnification outside the cap, because the excepted "Section 8" is the INDEMNIFICATION section (p0085-p0088). However the cap fails the fallback on two material terms: (i) the basis is not 12 months of fees but only amounts paid "FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO" in that period, a per-transaction slice that can fall far below 12 months' (indeed below 6 months') fees and is effectively illusory; and (ii) there are no carve-outs for breach of confidentiality (Section 10 is subject to the cap), gross negligence or wilful misconduct — those phrases appear nowhere in the document. We therefore made the shortest edit at the fallback level: deleted the transaction narrowing and added the three missing carve-outs to the existing exception opener. Short of preferred, we have not pressed for the greater-of USD 1,000,000 floor, "paid or payable", data-protection/IP/fraud carve-outs, or the payment-obligations exclusion; the mutual indirect/consequential damages exclusion in the second sentence is left intact.
